# Find Cloudflare Workers (`find_cloudflare_workers`)

MCP tool `repository_cloudflare_findWorkers` · scope `access_provider_connections` · read_only

Reads every visible Worker in the repository's stored Cloudflare account, observes each Worker's
current GitHub repository connection and Workers Builds root, and compares its tag and name with the
Workers that Samebase repositories already attach. Each Worker gets one attachment status: attached,
attached_elsewhere, attachable, connectable, connected_elsewhere, or unavailable. Only an attachable
Worker has one verified root for this repository's GitHub repository and can be attached. A
connectable Worker has no repository connection yet, and connecting it replaces what it serves.

The MCP result lists only attachable and connectable Workers, and counts the others by status. A
Worker that another Samebase repository attaches is only counted, without that repository. A partial
inventory never proves that an unlisted Worker is absent. Discovery may refresh private Samebase
provider-connection bookkeeping, but it writes no attachment or provider resource.

## Arguments

- `repository` (string, required): The repository as GitHub owner/name, or its repositoryId from
  repository_list.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "inventoryState": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "const": "complete"
        },
        {
          "const": "partial"
        }
      ]
    },
    "workers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "attachment": {
                "const": "attachable"
              },
              "workerName": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "rootDirectory": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": ["attachment", "workerName", "rootDirectory"],
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "attachment": {
                "const": "connectable"
              },
              "workerName": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": ["attachment", "workerName"],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "counts": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "attached": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "attachedElsewhere": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "connectedElsewhere": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "unavailable": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      },
      "required": ["attached", "attachedElsewhere", "connectedElsewhere", "unavailable"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": ["inventoryState", "workers", "counts"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
